seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Tombstone, Arizona for 2026: 5 family events, 3 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Tombstone celebrates Christmas Old West style, with a tree lighting on Allen Street, a lighted parade, a Victorian courthouse open house and a covered-wagon ride to Santa.
celebrates: Tombstone starts the season on Allen Street with a Chamber of Commerce tree lighting and a toy drive in a real stagecoach called Stuff the Stagecoach. The Chamber and City of Tombstone then present the Annual Holiday Light Parade, and Discover Tombstone hosts a Santa walk-down to light up Schieffelin Park. Tombstone Courthouse State Historic Park opens its Victorian Christmas for a free day of crafts, a pickle hunt and a magician. New this year, Santa's Desert Hideaway offers a covered-wagon ride to a Western Christmas experience.
lastyear: The Tombstone Chamber of Commerce's holiday events page still carries its 2025 description, which promoted the Chamber Holiday Tree Lighting, the Light Parade and more. The Stuff the Stagecoach toy drive image on the Discover Tombstone listing was uploaded in November 2023, so the drive has run for at least three seasons. The city's calendar lists the 2026 parade on the same Allen Street route.
facts: Tombstone calls itself a living town with a colorful history celebrated through events all year, according to the City of Tombstone's Discover Tombstone site. The Tombstone Courthouse is a two-story Victorian building that Arizona State Parks has turned into a museum about the legacy of the west's wildest mining town. At Christmas, the same building is decorated in its vintage holiday finest for the park's Victorian Christmas open house.
trains: Tombstone does not have a train depot of its own. The nearest rail stop on our site is the Benson Visitor Center Train Depot, a replica of the original depot in the Southern Pacific railroad town of Benson. For a Christmas ride in Tombstone itself, the wagon is the vehicle of choice: Santa's Desert Hideaway takes families by covered wagon through historic Tombstone to Santa's hideaway.

faq: When is the Tombstone Christmas tree lighting in 2026?

The Tombstone Chamber of Commerce and the City of Tombstone hold it on Friday, November 27, 2026. Hot cocoa and caroling start at 5:30 pm at Allen and 5th Streets, and the tree is lit at 6 pm. The Discover Tombstone calendar lists it as free.
When is the Tombstone Christmas parade?

The Annual Tombstone Holiday Light Parade is Saturday, December 12, 2026, starting at 6 pm on Allen Street from 6th to 3rd Street. Local businesses and residents decorate floats and vehicles with lights. The Chamber and the City sponsor it, and public parades are free to watch.
What is Victorian Christmas at the Tombstone Courthouse?

It is a free open house on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 9 am to 4:30 pm at Tombstone Courthouse State Historic Park. Arizona State Parks lists children's crafts, a Christmas pickle hunt with prizes, Faro and a magician. The courthouse museum is decorated for the holidays.

It is a Western Christmas experience that begins with a covered-wagon ride through historic Tombstone to Santa's desert hideaway, with festive activities. Opening night is November 27, 2026, with departures from the Sage Blossom Venue. Children 18 months and younger attend free. Prices are on the host's booking page.
